templates.source: http://www.escam.cn/product/60-en.html — ESCAM official product page (PVR001), Download/RTSP tab: 'rtsp://[IP]:[port]/live/[channel]/[stream_type]', IPC channel 0, main stream = main, default port 554 (same text on the PVR/Q6/QD800WIFI/QD900WIFI/QF508 pages)
http://www.escam.cn/product/60-en.html — ESCAM official product page (PVR001), Download/RTSP tab: sub stream = sub

notes: ESCAM publishes the RTSP URL per product on escam.cn product pages (second tab), and its lines use different firmware: (1) /live/<channel>/<main|sub> (channel 0 on IPCs) on the PVR, Q6, QD800WIFI, QD900WIFI and QF508 pages — used as the brand default here; (2) Xiongmai-style /user=<user>&password=<pass>&channel=1&stream=<0 main|1 sub>.sdp? on the QD100/QD300/QD410/QD420/QD500/QF007/QF218/QF288/QF518 pages; (3) /11 (main) and /12 (sub) on the G01/G02/Q2068 pages; (4) /ch0_0.264 (main) and /ch0_1.264 (sub) on RTSP port 80 on the QP180 page. Lines 2-4 carry their own rtsp_url_template on the camera records. Q8, QD900S, QF903, QH001/QH002/QH005 and TY003 pages publish no RTSP URL.
